definitions.final_gain_mentions: Gold canonical mention counts gained over Qwen final, clipped per reference.
definitions.gain_already_in_nonfinal_partial: Final gains whose canonical already occurred in an ordinary partial before end-of-input flush. For hybrid this is audio-availability replay, not a measured concurrent schedule.
definitions.gain_in_two_consecutive_nonfinal_partial: Same condition in two adjacent ordinary update events. This is an observation, not a guarantee the text never later changes.
definitions.native_vs_qwen: Native gains include a recognizer/model change, not only the hotword effect.
definitions.latency_limit: No wall-clock or gold spoken entity-end timestamps are inferred. A saved Qwen partial may already have paid network/model latency.
